name: Topology-based Non-Parametric Clustering
definition: A clustering method that decomposes the 2D feature space density plot into non-overlapping valley cells using Morse complex theory, without assuming the number or shape of clusters.
summary: Topology-based Non-Parametric Clustering decomposes 2D density plots into valley cells using topological features, avoiding spurious peaks and preserving spatial relationships unlike histogram-based methods.
